description: This source file provides functions related to system information retrieval specific to Broadcom devices, such as GPU RAM details and graphics resolution, by parsing proc filesystem entries. It contains utility functions for parsing and processing system info, along with functions to get total and free GPU RAM, and graphics width and height.

methods.name: sanitizeLine
methods.description: Removes extra white spaces in the input line.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Splits a line into tokens based on a specified delimiter.

methods.name: parse_proc_brcm_core
methods.description: Parses /proc/brcm/core to obtain GPU memory details based on a column header.

methods.name: parse_proc_brcm_display
methods.description: Parses /proc/brcm/display to obtain graphics resolution details.

methods.name: SoC_GetTotalGpuRam
methods.description: Returns total GPU RAM in bytes by reading system info.

methods.name: SoC_GetFreeGpuRam
methods.description: Calculates and returns free GPU RAM in bytes based on system usage.
